title: Awareness, consciousness and subjective experience name one target

statements.text: AST uses awareness, consciousness and subjective experience interchangeably for subjective awareness: a person judging, in their own opinion, that they perceived something. This is the component lost in blindsight and neglect, distinct from objective awareness, the ability to discriminate a stimulus above chance.

sources.quote: The attention schema theory aims to explain the nature and possible function of subjective awareness, the component that is lost in blindsight and neglect.
